description: Publish the first version of a site from a brand kit, with no mission and no credits (SHIP-540 ST.5). Only for a project SHIP made with Start from scratch. SHIP writes the kit, the site's address and pages made from the facts of the form into the repository, and that change deploys the site. Send the same site form as create_mission's starter, with brand.source preset. A brand from a website or a logo needs create_mission instead. A second call for the same site answers with the published site. Read get_site for liveDeployId: it is set once the site is live.

projectId.description: The project SHIP made, from list_projects

site.description: The form of a site starter. Required with starter; leave out title, description, labels and entry

about.description: website, blog and waitlist: the three answers every founder gives first. Ask the person all three. The other facts of the kind are optional

description.description: What the business does and for whom, in the person's words: 10 to 2000 characters

location.description: Where the business is, in the person's words: a town, an address, or online

name.description: The name of the business, 2 to 60 characters

author.description: blog, optional: the author of the first post. Without it, the business

brand.description: Where the brand comes from (one of three sources)

brandName.description: 2 to 60 characters, for the sources logo and preset. With about, send about.name

logo.description: The logo file, for the brand source logo

data.description: The file, base64-encoded, up to 2 MB

presetId.description: A preset id from list_brand_presets, for the source preset

source.description: website: SHIP captures the brand from websiteUrl. logo: from logo. preset: one of list_brand_presets

websiteUrl.description: An https URL that answers, for the source website

brandRights.description: The confirmation of the person the token acts for: they own this brand or have the right to use it. Send it only when that person confirmed the text that list_site_starters gives.

business.description: website: the optional answers of a type of business. list_site_starters gives each type and its questions. Send only the answers the person gave: the starter site leaves out a section with no answer

address.description: local-business: the street, the postcode and the town

bookingUrl.description: local-business: an https URL where customers book

hours.description: local-business: one to seven groups of days, each the days then the hours, such as Monday to Friday 08:00 to 18:00 or Sunday: closed

phone.description: local-business: the phone number customers call

prices.description: local-business: one to eight prices, each the name then the price with its currency, such as Brake service €25

type.description: A type from businessTypes of list_site_starters

language.description: The language of the site's words, from languages of list_site_starters. Without it, English

outline.description: docs: three to seven page titles

product.description: waitlist, optional: what people join the waitlist for. Without it, the business. Only a project SHIP made with Start from scratch takes a waitlist

productWebsite.description: docs: the product website, an https URL

slug.description: The site address: https://<slug>.letsship.app, 3 to 40 of a-z, 0-9 and hyphens

topic.description: blog, optional: the topic of the first post. Without it, the business

name: publish_starter_site
title: Publish a starter site
